comment: Generic MDM policy-as-data (fingerprint-free per owner decision 2026-11-11). Per-fingerprint overrides (system-app lists keyed by ro.build.fingerprint, never serial — D10) are added under fingerprints/ ONLY when the post-enrollment capture shows package-ID drift. Applied to the server/phone in Phases D1/D2, gated on DG-3/DG-4 on-device checks. 2026-11-19: Play Store is not policy-managed (owner decision) -- com.android.vending removed from locked_packages; containment is default-deny on use (DG-3). keep_system_apps already matches context.md D1. The locked_packages mechanism (ConfigUpdater.java:964 -> Utils.java lockPackages -> setApplicationHidden, comma-separated NO spaces) is retained as knowledge only; do not re-add com.android.vending. 2026-11-21: D0 debloat manifest added at etc/mdm/policy/debloat.json; whitelist_apps extended with LocalSend + Denet Storage (owner); keep_system_apps captive-portal ID corrected to the installed Google variant.
